tool.title: Verify a separated repository from a fresh clone
tool.description: Clone a separated sub-KG's repository (with submodules, and any sibling checkouts it needs) into an empty scratch directory, install, and run its gates: its `gates` script, else its `test` script (a person may pass `--gate` on the command line instead; it is not part of this contract because it is a shell command). Reports `green`, `red` or `unknown`; an empty tree, a failed clone or a repository with no gate is `unknown`, never green. Catches what a rehearsal inside this checkout cannot, because a rehearsal shares this checkout's `node_modules` and environment. Writes only inside the scratch directory.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The separated repository, `owner/name`. (The script also takes a git URL or a local path, for tests.)

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: The branch or tag to clone, e.g. the seeding PR's branch.

inputs.name: sibling
inputs.description: A repository to clone beside it, for a platform linked as a sibling checkout. Repeatable.

inputs.name: work
inputs.description: Scratch directory, kept afterwards. Absent: a temporary directory, removed afterwards.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: A report for a person instead of JSON.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: `sub-kg-verify-clone/v1`: the commit cloned, each step with its status and output tail, and the verdict. Exit 0 green, 1 red, 2 unknown.

selection.when: After a sub-KG's staged contents are seeded into its new repository and re-pointed, before asking the owner about the cutover.
selection.limits: Runs the repository's own gates as written; a gate that needs credentials or a service the clone cannot reach fails as it would for any new contributor.
selection.cost: A clone plus an install plus the gates: minutes for a small repository.

remedies.none: It verifies a clone of the new repository; with GitHub refused there is nothing to clone.

$comment.comment:
Bean `3tza`, owner ruling 2 (2026-10-06): stage 11 of `sub-kg-lifecycle`
("Verify on a fresh clone") is a command, as `seed:ready` became one.
